title: A game master teaches a wizard Fire Cat, which its spellbook takes at once and keeps across a relog, and takes it back
notes: A level 5 Fire wizard with no spell enters Ravenwood, and the game server logs that its book is empty.
The run opens the spellbook with P, the key the client's own InputBindings.xml gives ToggleDeckConfig, turns to its Fire page
and shoots it. Opening the spellbook sends MSG_CANSEETIEREDSPELLGROUPS, which asks which tiered spell groups the wizard may
upgrade; that waits for the milestone that answers tiered spells, so the run allows it.
'learn "Fire Cat" <wizard>' on the game server console teaches the spell: the server writes its character_spell row
and sends MSG_ADDSPELLTOBOOK with Fire Cat's template id, the hash of its name, and the book is shot again without a relog.
Learning it a second time is refused, so nothing is sent that the client would add twice.
The client is then quit and started again; the wizard must enter with Fire Cat in the player object's spellbook, which
the client builds its book from, and the book is shot a third time. 'unlearn' sends MSG_REMOVESPELLFROMBOOK and the
last shot shows the book without it. The client must never fail to load an object or to find a spell it is sent.
The spellbook is the Spell Deck window, which shows the book's cards only beside a worn deck: its DeckConfigurationWindow works
through the worn deck's DeckBehavior and logs m_deckBehavior NULL without one. So before anything is learned the game server's
console gives the wizard Deck-Tutorial-001, the Starter Deck, which nothing restricts, and a double-click on its backpack row wears
it in the Deck slot, stored in character_equipment and still worn after the relog. Wearing it makes the client send
MSG_SetDeckArchmastery with the deck's school, which waits for 8.11's decks, so the run allows it. The first card slot of the Fire
page is compared: empty, Fire Cat once learned, still Fire Cat after the relog and empty again once unlearned.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added
